    Bug 1970044 - Follow-up fix for schema annotations. r=aleca
    
    
    After the initial set of annotations landed, the webext-schema-generator
    was updated to process the new data and surfaced some minor errors:
    
    - additional max_manifest_version entries are needed by some annotation
      elements to properly identify the to-be-annotated element
    - `choices` need to specify the `type` property
    - the example code snippet used by `getFull` does not exists (never did)
    - the annotation for the `ThemeExperiment` type was specified on the
      wrong namespace
    - some of the used URLs were dead or had to be updated
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D252845
